commit.message:
Make sequence_of_statements a named node

This is a tweak to the grammar meant to improve the behavior of the Helix
editor's expand_selection command[1]. The particular situation where this
improves things is inside the then or else branches of if statements:
before this patch, expand_selection would go directly from a single
statement to the entire if statement, without stopping at the sequence
of statements of the then (or else) branch.

I also verified that this change improves Zed's Helix mode in the same
way as it improves Helix.

[1]: See https://docs.helix-editor.com/keymap.html#selection-manipulation
